4. Pressure Control System: The pressure control system is used to regulate the pressure of the lube oil, ensuring that it is always at the correct level and preventing damage to the engine.
5. AC Oil Pump: The AC oil pump is used to supply oil to the auxiliary components of the engine, such as the air conditioning system.
